title: Ask World
tagline: Human voice based feedback through world mini app, validated with AI, and stored in Walrus.

prizes.title: Innovator's Edge: for most impactful and useful AI Agent

description:
In a world flooded with forms, fake accounts, and impersonal feedback tools, capturing real human insights has become increasingly difficult. This decentralized platform transforms how surveys and feedback are collected—using voice of authenticated users from World, not forms, and AI, not manual review, to create a system that is faster, more authentic, and more inclusive.

The Problem:
Fake Responses & In-authentic Feedback
Traditional survey platforms are easily gamed by bots and fake accounts, leading to skewed data and unreliable insights.

Low Engagement from Participants
Feedback forms are long, boring, and often offer little to no incentive, discouraging meaningful participation.

Fragmented Global Representation
Most platforms lack diverse input from real users across the world, resulting in feedback that’s not truly representative.

Cumbersome Data Collection & Analysis
Manual, text-heavy surveys lead to slow turnaround times for insight generation and poor user experience.
 
***Our Solution:*** 
**Voice-Only, Verified Participation via World mini app**
All responses are submitted as short voice recordings—making it harder to fake, easier to verify, and more personal, with one human one voice with world authenticated users.

**Feedback Reward System**
Users are incentivized with payouts for sharing genuine feedback, increasing engagement and contribution quality.

**AI-Powered Transcription & Validation**
AI agents transcribe, validate, and analyze the voice data in real time, ensuring accurate alignment with questions and rewarding only valid responses.
how_its_made:
In our project, we harnessed the combined power of Worldcoin, the Superintelligence Alliance, and the Walrus to create a robust and efficient humanistic feedback system. World's mini app enabled us to reach verified users, and the Superintelligence Alliance  uAgents framework helped verify and analyze the user voice feedback to generate pick the right answers for the survey results. Storing on Walrus gives our data retrieval efficiency, resilience, and user control.

Users submit audio answers to questions, which are automatically stored on Walrus (decentralized data storage), transcribed by voice agents, and validated by AI agents on Agentverse. The settlement layer for payments and platform management is handled by smart contracts deployed on WorldChain. Valid answers receive bounty payments, creating a sustainable ecosystem for knowledge exchange.
